in_sanskrit.name: अयनिल
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who goes towards the sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A person who is moving or headed towards the sun, or a name for the sun god, Surya.

in_hindi.name: अयनिल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ayanil is a Hindi name that translates to 'Dear to the Sun' or 'Beloved of the Sun God'.

in_tamil.name: அயனில்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ayanil is a Tamil name that means 'Graceful Sun' or 'Sun that bestows grace'.

in_telugu.name: అయనిల్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ayanil is a Telugu name that means 'One who goes towards the sun' or 'Sun worshiper'.

in_marathi.name: Ayanil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayanil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ayana' (Moon) and 'Ila' (Delight). This name is believed to be the delight of the Moon God, Ayanil is a beautiful and mystical name for a baby boy in Hindu culture.
